purpose: Separate generator competence from PM selection and executor realization before any head verdict.

primary_exam.name: ESC-Eval
primary_exam.role_card_identity: official high-quality 655-card surface at repository commit 9ad46e7b5e247e824dae4633910eaa82be668beb
primary_exam.aggregation: Report language, dimension, role-card, and cluster uncertainty separately; no sole composite pass.
primary_exam.scorer_rule: ESC-RANK is UNQUALIFIED until its exact runtime reproduces a declared human-label calibration target. If public calibration labels are unavailable, label the official scorer UNQUALIFIED and predeclare an alternative with human anchors.

sensitivity_exam.name: ESC-Judge
sensitivity_exam.role_identity: A project-frozen subset from the 100 public roles; the unpublished paper-25 identity must not be implied.
sensitivity_exam.pairing: Candidate and same-stack reference receive the same role. Every comparison is judged in both A/B orders.
sensitivity_exam.position_policy: A result is stable only when the winner is unchanged or both orientations resolve to tie; order-flip disagreement is POSITION_UNSTABLE.
sensitivity_exam.tie_invalid_policy: TIE, INVALID, REFUSAL, and POSITION_UNSTABLE are explicit outcomes and never coerced to a win.
sensitivity_exam.judge_identity: Exact provider/model snapshot, prompt hash, temperature, seed if supported, retry, and parser must be bound before calls.
sensitivity_exam.human_anchor: A blinded role-stratified sample receives two independent reviewers; discrepancies measure instrument reliability, not candidate correctness alone.

executor_exam.name: approved-plan-and-evidence-realization
executor_exam.input: Same context plus a frozen approved response plan and authorized evidence/resource delta.
executor_exam.interpretation: Identifies whether a qualified ESC generator can execute PM outputs; it is not selector evidence.

requirements: not trained or tuned on the qualification outputs
identical cards, turns, sampling policy, retry, and scoring

forbidden: copy a published model delta across different stacks
margin_derivation.decision: Margins remain unset until these inputs exist; no generator pass/fail may be issued meanwhile.

decision_tree.then: Consider leakage-screened ESC SFT and rerun qualification.

decision_tree.if: ESC passes but executor realization fails
decision_tree.then: Train only plan/evidence execution, not the selector, then rerun executor and qualification.

decision_tree.if: ESC and executor pass but PM fails
decision_tree.then: Repair candidate, treatment, or selector; generator tuning cannot rescue the claim.

decision_tree.if: ESC and executor pass and PM passes
decision_tree.then: Freeze the generator for every PM and baseline comparison.

authority: This contract authorizes design and zero-API implementation only. It does not authorize model downloads, inference, paid judges, or fine-tuning.
